findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Identify format and mod methods in Markup class
 * @description Find the definition of format and __mod__ methods in markupsafe.Markup class
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/identify-markup-format-methods
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Function f
where
    f.getScope().getName() = "Markup" and
    f.getName() in ["format", "__mod__"]
select f, f.getName()
findings.hypothesis: Identify format and mod methods to check for proper escaping implementation.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect Markup format and mod implementation
 * @description List calls made within Markup.format and Markup.__mod__ to verify escaping
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/inspect-markup-impl
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Function f, Call c, Class cls
where
  cls.getName() = "Markup" and
  f = cls.getAMethod() and
  f.getName() in ["format", "__mod__"] and
  c.getScope() = f
select f, "Method " + f.getName() + " calls " + c.getFunc().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Verifying that Markup.format and Markup.__mod__ call escape or similar functions to sanitize inputs.
